name: Miori Isamu
source:
Shizuku’s husband and Haruto’s father.

He works as the Sales Department Manager at “Uranami House,” a major real estate company in the city. He has a strong sense of responsibility and a serious personality. However, because of his seriousness, he lacks flexibility in some areas.

He met Shizuku through an arranged meeting. After dating for about two years, he proposed, and they got married.

After Shizuku gave birth to Haruto, his serious nature led him to throw himself into work for the sake of his wife and child. As a result, he became a husband and father who rarely paid attention to his family.

By dedicating himself to his work and producing results, he was steadily promoted to Sales Department Manager. While his promotion increased his income and stabilized the household finances, the responsibilities of his managerial position made him even busier. He began coming home later and later, creating a growing distance between himself and both his wife Shizuku and his son Haruto.

He performs his job very competently, and from the company’s perspective he is an excellent employee. However, he has not been able to become a good husband or father.

Although their marriage has become sexless, he still loves his wife Shizuku and cares deeply about his son Haruto. However, because he believes that “working hard to stabilize the family finances = making his family happy,” he has been unable to bridge the emotional gap that has formed between him and his wife.

(Machine Translated Description from the Eroit product page.)
